workouts.title: KAKS 1.1 (Week 1, Workout 1)
workouts.description: 1:30 x Child’s Pose with Bench Ease in and out of position every 7-10 seconds 3 Sets 5 x Standing Banded Hollow Hollow out lower back and recruit lats both in hanging and standing positions 10 Sets 10sec x Bent Knee Hollow Hold Rest 10 sec 10sec x Superman Hold Rest 10 sec 2 Sets 5-10sec x Kip Swings Rest walk 1 minute Video both sets even if you don't feel you can do this well, try your best. We need something to compare your progress, too.

workouts.title: KAKS 1.2 (Week 1, Workout 2)
workouts.description: 2 Sets 1:00 x Shoulder Extension 6 x Yoga Push Ups Pause in top position of downward dog 3 Sets 10 x Kip Swing (one foot on box) Pause in hollow and arch for 5 reps then 5 reps with momentum 6:00 for quality 10 x Flutter Kicks Keep lower back on floor, and shoulders off floor during kicks. 5 x Curl Up with 3sec Hold Rest as needed Accumulate 1:00 in minimal sets Active Bar Hang

workouts.title: KAKS 1.3 (Week 1, Workout 3)
workouts.description: 3 Sets 6 x Prone PVC Raises 3 x Floor TTB with 5sec down Press against the bar to engage your lats during floor TTB. Ensure you’re pulling into rig, not away from. 4 Sets 5 x Banded Kip Swing Set band up at shoulder height (when hanging). Use a heavy band. 4 Sets 6 x Hollow Body Band Pull-over To stay in hollow lower back to contact with floor, shoulders off the floor. Straight arms. 10sec x Ring Plank Hold

workouts.title: KAKS 2.1 (Week 2, Workout 1)
workouts.description: In Week 2, we’ll continue building your core strength and refining your kipping skills. Be sure to record your kip and compare it to earlier videos. Awareness is key to progress. If you’re a WODprep Academy athlete, don’t forget you can share your video and questions in the Academy Coaching space. Getting feedback and corrections is a great way to accelerate your improvement. 3 Sets 5 x Seated Single Leg Lifts (each leg) 8 x Band Pull-downs 8 x Band Pull-aparts with 3sec Eccentric 3 Sets 40 sec x Passive to Active Hang (3sec in each position) Rest as needed before next set 6:00 for Quality 5 x Hollow Rocks 5 x Arch Rocks Rest 10 sec If you struggle with extending your legs in the hollow rock, bend your knees. 2 Sets 5-10sec x Kip Swings Rest 1 minute between sets Film each set and Compare to Week 1 Acamdey Athletes, share your video and questions with a WODprep Coach to fast track your progress. Name your post “Kip Swing 2.1” and choose the topic “Pull-up”

workouts.title: KAKS 2.2 (Week 2, Workout 2)
workouts.description: 2 Sets 1:00 x Shoulder Extension 8 x Yoga Push Ups Pause in top position of downward dog 3 Sets 10 x Banded Kip Swing Rest as needed Actively push shoulders back into band 5 Sets 8 x Alternating Single Leg Lowers 20sec x Ring Plank Hold Aim to keep lower back on floor for Leg Lowers. Maintain hollow position with Ring Plank Hold. Accumulate 2:00 in minimal sets Active Bar Hang

workouts.title: KAKS 2.3 (Week 2, Workout 3)
workouts.description: 3 Sets 6 x Ring Fall Out 3 x Floor TTB With 5sec Eccentric (legs extended) 3 Sets 6 x Lat Push Back Avoid bending at hip, only the angle of shoulder should close. Use lats to push back as far as you can then come to a stop (no arch). 3 Sets 8 x Hollow Body Band Pull-Over 20sec x Ring Plank Hold
